caption: Pressure RMSE and MAE on 41 fixed validation wings at the measured target training budgets. Points and error bars are the mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of training seeds 3407, 3408 and 3409, not confidence intervals. Both surfaces exclude LE0 and the tip cap (eta >= 0.9975). Validation was used for checkpoint selection. Connecting segments are guides between observed budgets, not additional evaluated samples.
